properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, 2026-07-25): start from the next release; the nine shipped releases are left as they are. Retro-editing them to claim a contents-line nobody wrote at the time would reconstruct history rather than record it, which dec:intent-preserved exists to prevent — those releases genuinely did ship a README and a setup guide, but the design did not model documentation as a deliverable until today, and when the understanding arrived is itself a true fact worth keeping. The obligation is forward and concrete: the next release cut must list cmp:docs in its contents, and the release checklist in AGENTS.md now says so, because an intention recorded only in an acknowledgement is one nobody reads at the moment it matters.
